narration: Ishaan snaps it anyway. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
caption: इशान फिर भी चटकाता है। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
image_brief: A tiny crocodile nose shadow closing inside a narrow band of light on the wall, Ishaan's face dim beside it.

narration: A nose snaps in a stripe. That is all.
caption: पट्टी में सिर्फ़ एक नाक चटकती है। बस इतना ही।
image_brief: The thin stripe on the wall holding one small dark shape, the rest of the wall completely black.

narration: His sister's rabbit does not fit either. Two ears, no room.
caption: बहन का खरगोश भी नहीं समाता। दो कान, जगह नहीं।
image_brief: The sister's two rabbit-ear fingers squeezed into the thin light with only one ear tip showing as shadow.

narration: She says the torch is spoiled. She says it is Ishaan's fault.
caption: वह कहती है टॉर्च बिगड़ गई। और यह इशान की ग़लती है।
image_brief: The sister sitting with folded arms in her cot facing away, the broken torch lying on the floor between the cots.

narration: Their grandmother speaks from the doorway. Ten minutes, then lights out.
caption: दादी दरवाज़े से कहती हैं। दस मिनट, फिर बत्ती बंद।
image_brief: The grandmother in a shawl standing in the bedroom doorway with hallway light behind her, both children looking up at her.

narration: Ten minutes. Two children. One stripe of light.
caption: दस मिनट। दो बच्चे। रोशनी की एक पट्टी।
image_brief: The thin stripe of light on the floorboards with two pairs of small bare feet on either side of it.

narration: Grandmother offers to mend the torch tomorrow. Tomorrow is too late.
caption: दादी कहती हैं कल टॉर्च ठीक कर देंगी। कल बहुत देर हो जाएगी।
image_brief: The grandmother holding up one open palm in the doorway as she speaks, the loose torch still lying on the floorboards.

narration: Ishaan tries the old way, faster. The stripe slices his crocodile thin.
caption: इशान पुराना तरीक़ा जल्दी-जल्दी दोहराता है। पट्टी उसके मगरमच्छ को पतला काट देती है।
image_brief: Ishaan's hands working quickly in the narrow beam, a sliver of crocodile shadow flickering on the wall.

narration: Ishaan twists the loose glass to widen it. It rattles and stays narrow.
caption: इशान ढीले काँच को घुमाकर पट्टी चौड़ी करना चाहता है। वह खड़खड़ाती है, पतली ही रहती है।
image_brief: Ishaan sitting on the floor turning the torch's loose front glass with both thumbs, the thin beam shaking on the wall.

narration: Eight minutes. Ishaan's sister will not look up.
caption: आठ मिनट। इशान की बहन ऊपर नहीं देखती।
image_brief: The sister lying down facing the wall with her blanket over one ear, the lit stripe crossing the floor behind her.

narration: Ishaan sets the torch on the stool again. The stripe lands flat.
caption: इशान टॉर्च को फिर स्टूल पर रखता है। पट्टी सीधी पड़ जाती है।
image_brief: The torch lying on its side on the wooden stool, its narrow beam falling in a long line across the floorboards.

narration: Ishaan does not want a wall crocodile. He wants the ceiling.
caption: इशान को दीवार का मगरमच्छ नहीं चाहिए। उसे छत चाहिए।
image_brief: Ishaan sitting back on his heels on the floor with his chin lifted toward the dark, empty ceiling.

narration: Six minutes left. Ishaan's stripe lies long and thin.
caption: छह मिनट बचे हैं। इशान की पट्टी लंबी और पतली पड़ी है।
image_brief: A long thin band of light stretching from the foot of the stool across the floorboards to the bedroom door.

narration: Long and thin is crocodile-shaped. But it is on the floor.
caption: लंबी और पतली चीज़ मगरमच्छ जैसी होती है। पर वह फ़र्श पर है।
image_brief: The long stripe of light on the floorboards, narrow like a crocodile lying down, the ceiling above it in darkness.

narration: Ishaan stacks his four story books on the stool.
caption: इशान अपनी चार कहानी की किताबें स्टूल पर चढ़ा देता है।
image_brief: Ishaan piling four thick story books one on top of another on the wooden stool, the loose torch lit beside his knee.
